---
description: Requirement and change identifiers for Image Studio development
applyTo: "**"
---

For Image Studio tasks, including related host routes, login, storage and
documentation work, follow
[Image Studio requirement traceability](../../extensions/image-studio/AGENTS.md)
before making changes. Use the canonical Obsidian overview to allocate or reuse
REQ/CHG identifiers; keep the records synchronized and include both identifiers
in development summaries and explicitly authorized commit messages.

This convention does not apply to unrelated FastbuildAI work.
